title: Acute breathlessness: moderate asthma exacerbation
intended_use: Synthetic formative clinical education only; not a patient-care protocol or prescribing aid.

source_basis.title: Global Strategy for Asthma Management and Prevention, 2026
source_basis.used_for: Adult acute-asthma assessment dimensions and moderate-presentation descriptors. The case is a synthetic teaching adaptation, not a reproduction of the full guideline.

source_basis.title: Summary Guide for Asthma Management and Prevention, 2026
source_basis.used_for: Moderate-presentation teaching context and reassessment concepts. Local institutional protocols and clinician review remain required.

educational_purpose: Practise focused assessment, severity recognition, objective assessment, timely treatment planning, reassessment, documentation and handover in a deterministic synthetic encounter.
learning_objectives: Perform a focused initial assessment and identify severity features and immediate red flags.
Use objective lung-function assessment when it can be obtained without delaying urgent care.
Select and document an appropriate initial treatment plan within the scenario's reviewed action catalogue.
Advance simulated time deliberately and reassess the patient's response.
Document findings, uncertainty, plan and handover in a structured form.

patient.name: Synthetic patient A
patient.presenting_complaint: Worsening breathlessness and wheeze since yesterday.
patient.opening_history: Known asthma. Reports increased reliever use during the last day and is unsure whether the current inhaler is helping.

history_after_assessment.onset: Worsening over approximately 24 hours after an upper-respiratory illness.
history_after_assessment.reliever_use: More frequent than usual; exact number of uses is not supplied.
history_after_assessment.maintenance_therapy: Current regimen and adherence require clarification.
history_after_assessment.previous_critical_events: Not yet established; ask about prior intensive-care admission or ventilation.
history_after_assessment.anaphylaxis_features: No associated rash, facial swelling or hypotensive symptoms reported in this synthetic history; reassess if new information appears.

simulation_model.clinical_fidelity_note: A deliberately bounded educational transition model. It is not a validated physiological model, does not predict real treatment response, and must not be used for patient care.

focused_assessment.label: Complete focused assessment
focused_assessment.description: Review the focused history, examination and immediate severity features.

order_peak_flow.label: Order peak expiratory flow
order_peak_flow.description: Request objective lung-function measurement. The result becomes available after two simulated minutes.

administer_bronchodilator.label: Administer inhaled bronchodilator (scenario protocol)
administer_bronchodilator.description: Record the scenario's pre-reviewed bronchodilator action. No dose is specified by this educational model.

start_systemic_corticosteroid.label: Start systemic corticosteroid (scenario protocol)
start_systemic_corticosteroid.description: Record the scenario's treatment-plan action. This model does not simulate an immediate bronchodilator effect or specify a dose.

escalate_for_senior_review.label: Request senior clinical review
escalate_for_senior_review.description: Record escalation when deterioration, uncertainty or local policy makes senior review appropriate.

reassess_patient.label: Reassess after initial treatment period
reassess_patient.description: Record a structured reassessment at or after 60 simulated minutes.

criteria.label: Focused assessment completed
criteria.basis: A PROforma-gated focused assessment action is recorded.

criteria.label: Objective lung-function measurement obtained
criteria.basis: Peak-flow result is available; full points when obtained before bronchodilator without delaying treatment, partial points when obtained later.

criteria.label: Initial bronchodilator action recorded
criteria.basis: A scenario-protocol bronchodilator action is accepted; timing is reflected in the breakdown.

criteria.label: Systemic corticosteroid plan recorded
criteria.basis: A PROforma-gated treatment-plan action is recorded; free-text dose assessment is not automated.

criteria.label: Response reassessed
criteria.basis: A formal reassessment is recorded after the initial treatment period and the modelled response window.

criteria.label: Structured clinical note completeness
criteria.basis: Presence of assessment, findings, plan and uncertainty fields only; prose quality is not automatically graded.

criteria.label: Structured handover completeness
criteria.basis: Presence of situation, background, assessment, recommendation and outstanding-task fields.

limitations: This is formative scenario-process feedback, not a clinical competence score.
Free-text clinical reasoning is not semantically graded.
The rubric requires review by qualified clinical educators before wider use.
More than one clinically defensible sequence may be accepted by future reviewed rubric versions.

prompts: Which initial findings most influenced your assessment of severity?
What did the peak-flow result add, and did obtaining it delay treatment?
Which actions changed the simulated patient's state, and which had no immediate modelled effect?
What did you reassess, and what remained uncertain?
What would you document or communicate differently in a real supervised clinical setting?
